src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2012 plan: SB 202, Chapter 18 of the Laws of 2012 (RSA 662:1 as then in force); 2 districts
NH General Court docket SB 202 (2012), 'apportioning congressional districts': signed 04/23/2012; Chapter 18; effective 06/22/2012
Verified against the file: adding the RSA 662:1 counties and towns of District 1 from Census land areas gives 6,384.31 sq km; the cb_2020 cd116 file has 6,384.30 sq km.
